scalars.scalar_value: High School Diploma or equivalent experience/training.
At least one (1) year of experience as a Heavy Duty Mechanic, performing preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of heavy-duty vehicles and equipment.

items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California Class B driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) Certification(s)
High School Diploma or equivalent experience/training.
At least one (1) year of experience as a Heavy Duty Mechanic, performing preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of heavy-duty vehicles and equipment.
The role of this position is to perform duties related to the support, maintenance, repair and upkeep of the vehicle fleet. #CA-SB
60% - Preventative Maintenance, Service and Repairs
30% - System Administration & Standard Operating Procedure Adherence
Coordinate work activities and manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
Employee is required to supply and maintain a personal inventory of basic hand tools necessary to perform the essential functions of the position.
Knowledge of heavy-duty vehicle systems, components, and repair techniques.
Working knowledge of providing mobile repair and roadside service support.
Skilled in performing preventative maintenance, inspections, adjustments, and component replacement.
Ability to operate diagnostic equipment, hand tools, power tools, and testing instruments safely and effectively.
Ability to diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, fuel, brake, steering, suspension, transmission, heating/air conditioning, and engine-related systems.
Skill in reading and interpreting technical manuals, schematics, repair procedures, and manufacturer specifications.
Ability to safely work with up to 600 volt DC currents, as position requires repairing of electric carts and hybrid vehicles.
Knowledge of safety regulations, hazardous materials handling, and safe shop operating procedures.
Skilled in documenting repairs, labor hours, parts usage, and maintenance records with accuracy.
Ability to perform environmental protection requirements from Federal, State and Local agencies.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Supervisors, coworkers, vendors, and customers regarding repair schedules and service needs.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as a member of a team.
Skills to work effectively and efficiently with computer applications including Microsoft office suite and fleet management software.
Ability to safely perform physically demanding work, including lifting equipment and working in confined or awkward spaces.
